LightningComponentBundle.description: Product Configurator Flow Screen component that sets the start date, end date and subscription term on the product being configured.

property.name: transactionLineId
property.label: Transaction Line ID
property.description: Data Manager transactionLineId: the root line being configured.

property.name: salesTransactionItems
property.label: Sales Transaction Items
property.description: Data Manager salesTransactionItems; used to seed the current dates.

property.name: isApiInProgress
property.label: Is API In Progress
property.description: Data Manager isApiInProgress; inputs are disabled while true.

property.name: isConfiguratorDisabled
property.label: Is Configurator Disabled
property.description: Data Manager isConfiguratorDisabled; inputs are disabled while true.

property.name: startDateField
property.label: Start Date Field
property.description: Line field to write the start date to. Defaults to StartDate.

property.name: endDateField
property.label: End Date Field
property.description: Line field to write the end date to. Defaults to EndDate.

property.name: contextMetadata
property.label: Context Metadata
property.description: Data Manager contextMetadata; the Start/End Date attribute ids are discovered from it.
